* 3 [[Crystal Shard of Phantasms]] → [[Crystal Disc of Phantasms]]

* [[Essence of Horrors]]
* [[Essence of Nightmares]]

* [[Essence of Torments]]

* [[Crystal Disc of Dreams]] - 6 each of above 4 essences or 6 shards
* [[Crystal Disc of Dreams]] - can be purchase for 50 [[astral shard|astral shards]] at the [[Dreamforge]].
